svg.title: Local 90-minute best-score trajectories
svg.desc: 71 scalar observations from 13 scored runs. Lines connect best-so-far scores at submission timestamps. Independent task scales; no fit or confidence bands. Two runs lack native final results.
svg.text: 90-minute local budget · best score so far · higher is better
Lines end at the last submission.
No fitted curve or confidence band.
not a test of the current repair head.
